title: UltraView
description: What the ultra screen shows. Exactly these fields.

next_station.description: The aid station being run to. Starts at Ridge Hut; moves on with each CheckIn.

distance_km.description: Course distance covered, km: the distance of the station last checked in at (0 before any) plus the GPS track distance since that check-in (since the first fix before any).

to_next_km.description: The next station's distance minus distance_km, km; never below 0.

eta_ms.description: When the runner will reach the next station, epoch ms: the latest time plus to_next_km at the pace of about the last 10 minutes. null until there is a recent pace.

in_hand_ms.description: The next station's cutoff (race start, i.e. the first fix's time, plus its cutoff) minus eta_ms, ms. Negative when on course to miss it. null when eta_ms is null.
